description: Frontend application: Complete React+TypeScript+Vite frontend with responsive UI, authentication flows, dashboard, client management, service/payment modules, reports with charts, and Excel export. Mobile-first design using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components.
steps: Initialize frontend/ with Vite + React + TypeScript template: npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts
Install and configure Tailwind CSS 3, PostCSS, autoprefixer in frontend/
Install and configure shadcn/ui: initialize with default theme, add components (button, input, card, table, dialog, dropdown-menu, tabs, badge, avatar, sheet, sidebar, chart, form, select, toast)
Install additional deps: react-router-dom, axios, @tanstack/react-query, recharts, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, zod, date-fns, lucide-react, xlsx (for client-side export fallback)
Create frontend/src/lib/api.ts with Axios instance configured with base URL, JWT interceptor (attach token from localStorage), and 401 response interceptor (redirect to login)
Create frontend/src/lib/auth-context.tsx with AuthContext provider: login, logout, user state, role check helpers, auto-logout on inactivity (configurable timeout)
Create frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx - professional login page with email/password form, 'Forgot password' link, form validation with zod
Create frontend/src/pages/ForgotPassword.tsx - email input form to request password reset
Create frontend/src/pages/ResetPassword.tsx - new password form (accessed via reset token in URL)
Create frontend/src/components/layout/DashboardLayout.tsx - responsive sidebar layout with navigation, user avatar/menu, mobile hamburger menu (Sheet component)
Create frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx - collapsible sidebar with nav links: Dashboard, Clientes, Servicios, Pagos, Reportes, Usuarios (admin only), Configuracion (admin only)

Create frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx - main dashboard with stat cards (total clients, active services, monthly revenue, pending payments) and charts (monthly revenue bar chart, client type pie chart, top services)
Create frontend/src/pages/clients/ClientList.tsx - data table with search, filter by type, pagination, soft-delete toggle, 'New Client' button (admin only)
Create frontend/src/pages/clients/ClientForm.tsx - create/edit client form with all fields, client type selector, validation
Create frontend/src/pages/clients/ClientDetail.tsx - client detail view with tabs: General Info, Services (with custom pricing), Payments (with proof uploads), Financial History
Create frontend/src/pages/services/ServiceList.tsx - service catalog management, default pricing, categories
Create frontend/src/pages/services/ServiceForm.tsx - create/edit service with name, description, default price, category
Create frontend/src/pages/services/ClientServiceAssignment.tsx - assign services to client with custom price override, period selection (monthly/annual)
Create frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentList.tsx - payments table with status badges, filters by date range/client/status, bulk actions
Create frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentForm.tsx - record payment with client selector, amount, period, file upload for proof (PDF/image)
Create frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentProofViewer.tsx - modal/dialog to view uploaded payment proofs (PDF viewer / image display)
Create frontend/src/pages/reports/Reports.tsx - report generation page with filters (date range, client type, service type), download as Excel button
Create frontend/src/pages/reports/ClientReport.tsx - individual client report card with full history, downloadable
Create frontend/src/pages/users/UserList.tsx - user management (admin only) with role assignment
Create frontend/src/pages/users/UserForm.tsx - create/edit user with role selection
Create frontend/src/components/ui/ - ensure all shadcn components are properly set up and themed
Create frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts, useClients.ts, useServices.ts, usePayments.ts, useReports.ts - custom hooks wrapping react-query for data fetching
Create frontend/src/App.tsx with React Router setup: protected routes, role-based route guards, lazy loading for pages
Ensure full mobile responsiveness: test all layouts collapse properly, sidebar becomes sheet on mobile, tables become cards on small screens
Create frontend/vite.config.ts with proxy to backend API in development mode
acceptance_criteria: Running 'cd frontend && npm install && npm run build' completes without errors
Login page renders with email/password fields and forgot password link
Dashboard shows stat cards and placeholder charts
Client list page shows a data table with search and filter controls
Client detail page has tabs for info, services, payments, history
Service assignment supports custom pricing per client
Payment form allows file upload for proof documents
Reports page has date range and type filters with export button
All pages are responsive - sidebar collapses on mobile, tables adapt
Route guards prevent standard users from accessing admin pages
Inactivity auto-logout works after configurable timeout
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/contable/frontend && npm install && npm run build
findings: Zod v4 was installed by default (npm latest) but is incompatible with @hookform/resolvers z.coerce API. Downgraded to zod@3 (3.25.76) for full compatibility. TypeScript 5.8 deprecates baseUrl in tsconfig - removed it and relied on paths alone which works with the bundler module resolution. Vite v8 and tsc-b work correctly with the final config. tailwindcss-animate required as a dependency for shadcn/ui animation classes.
